words.def: A word you say when you meet someone.
words.ex: Hello, my name is Ali.

words.def: A word you say when you leave.
words.ex: Goodbye! See you tomorrow.

words.def: A polite word you use when you ask for something.
words.ex: Please sit here.

words.def: A word you say when you did something wrong.
words.ex: I am sorry I am late.

words.def: The word that people call you.
words.ex: My name is Sara.

words.def: Your female parent.
words.ex: My mother cooks very well.
words.exfa: مادر من خیلی خوب آشپزی میکند.

words.def: Your male parent.
words.ex: My father works in a bank.
words.exfa: پدر من در یک بانک کار میکند.

words.def: A boy or man with the same parents as you.
words.ex: My brother is older than me.
words.exfa: برادر من از من بزرگتر است.

words.def: A person you like and know well.
words.ex: She is my best friend.

words.def: A place where children learn.
words.ex: I walk to school every morning.
words.exfa: من هر صبح پیاده به مکتب میروم.

words.def: A person who helps students learn.
words.ex: The teacher writes on the board.

words.def: Pages with words that you read.
words.ex: I read a book before sleep.
words.exfa: من قبل از خواب کتاب میخوانم.

words.def: A tool you use to write with ink.
words.ex: Can I borrow your pen?
words.exfa: آیا میتوانم قلم تو را قرض بگیرم؟

words.def: A common food made from flour.
words.ex: We eat bread for breakfast.

words.def: A clear liquid that you drink.
words.ex: I drink water every day.

words.def: A hot drink made from leaves.
words.ex: My grandfather drinks green tea.

words.def: A person who helps sick people.
words.ex: The doctor says I should rest.
words.exfa: داکتر میگوید که باید استراحت کنم.

words.def: A place where people buy and sell things.
words.ex: We buy fruit at the market.
words.exfa: ما میوه را از بازار میخریم.

words.def: What you use to buy things.
words.ex: I do not have enough money.

words.def: To get something by paying money.
words.ex: I want to buy a new bag.

words.def: A vehicle with four wheels.
words.ex: His car is very old.

words.def: To move from one place to another.
words.ex: I go to work by bus.
words.exfa: من با بس به کار میروم.

words.def: To put food in your mouth and swallow it.
words.ex: We eat dinner at eight.

words.def: Large in size.
words.ex: They live in a big house.
words.exfa: آنها در یک خانهٔ بزرگ زندگی میکنند.

words.def: Feeling good because something nice happened.
words.ex: I am happy to see you.
